source_note: Static, build-free inventory of the code seams that assume a document frame is a top-level WorkWindow/SystemWindow (the historical tdf#37134 failure mode). This registry claims NO runtime tabs capability: it is an add-only guardrail so that a later document-tabs change which violates a topness assumption fails bin/check-frame-topness-seams.py instead of shipping a latent crash. Each entry is classified host-owned / tab-owned / audited-safe (there are no 'unaudited' entries; an 'unaudited' entry fails the checker closed). Snippets and counts are pinned to the current tree and re-derived by the checker with the recorded git-grep patterns; any drift (a new call site absent here, or a removed one) fails closed.

classification_vocabulary.host-owned: Seam belongs to the shared top-level host window; under tabs it must follow the host/active tab, never a fixed top document frame.
classification_vocabulary.tab-owned: Seam currently assumes the document frame is top but conceptually belongs to a per-tab view frame; must be re-pointed when tabs land.
classification_vocabulary.audited-safe: Reviewed: resolves the enclosing SystemWindow generically or is the seam's own definition/diagnostic; no single-top-document assumption.
classification_vocabulary.unaudited: Not yet reviewed. Illegal in a passing registry -- the checker fails closed on any 'unaudited' entry.
